thread:
maya: Heads up — finalizing launch criteria for the tenant‑SLA pilot next sprint. Need a quick handshake on runtime / infra / security gating before we lock scope.

sam: Quick q — what's the minimal capacity target for the pilot? We need GPU slots + prewarm windows to estimate cost.

maya: Target is 5 tenants, ~2 qps each, p50 latency <= 200ms for generation. If we can't hit p50 we plan a reduced concurrency fallback.

riley: Infra notes: 5 tenants is fine but we need a reserved node pool + prewarm jobs. Recommend reserving 2x headroom for burst. Also note: private tenants will require KMS/HSM access.

jordan: Security: KMS is in scope. If any tenant requires HSM-backed keys we need certing + audit log config; that adds ~3 business days to onboarding.

sam: From runtime side: model quantization + batching will help. Proposed baseline batching: window 20ms, max_size 8. We can tune per-tenant.

priya: SRE ask: define canary and rollback triggers. Propose canary window 1h; rollback if error rate >1% or latency regresses >20% vs baseline. Also need automatic fallback to a smaller model on sustained tail latency.

maya: @riley — can infra commit to node reservation + prewarm scripts by EOD Friday? That deadline decides whether we keep the full generation scope or cut to embeddings-only pilot.

riley: I can commit to prewarm scripts + a 2-node reserved pool by Fri 17:00 UTC. HSM provisioning might slip; if HSM isn't ready we'll default to KMS-only and mark affected tenants as non-HSM.

jordan: That's acceptable for the early pilot, but we must flag the deviation in compliance docs and customer communications.

sam: Example canary config I'll test with the harness: ```yaml
batcher:
  window_ms: 20
  max_size: 8
routing:
  fallback_model: llama-small-q4
```

maya: Plan / owners: Riley — reserve nodes + prewarm (owner: @riley). Jordan — confirm HSM timeline & compliance flag (owner: @jordan). Sam — prepare canary config and test harness (owner: @sam). Priya — draft rollback runbook and alert thresholds (owner: @priya). I'll update the product acceptance criteria doc once items land.

priya: :thumbsup: I'll add SLA thresholds + dashboards (p50/p95/p99, errors, model fallback count). Ping me if you want specific panels.

riley: I'll open the infra PR with `prewarm.sh` and terraform for the reservation in #eng-infra and link here. ETA Fri 17:00 UTC.

maya: Great. Reconvene Thu 10:00am sync to cut final scope. Thanks all :raised_hands:
